projects.name: Archivist
projects.summary: A local-first document research tool that helps people find information in their own files and draw conclusions grounded in them.
projects.feature: The current build focuses on document processing and semantic retrieval: extracting text, indexing it locally, and finding passages related to your question. Retrieved passages feed a locally run model, so answers come from your documents and stay traceable to their sources.

projects.name: FrostOS
projects.summary: A fast, easily provisioned 64-bit custom kernel operating system for gamers, everyday users, and fleets, with compatibility layers for Linux and Windows apps.
projects.feature: The kernel bring-up is underway: boot, memory management, and a scheduler tuned for a small number of long-running tasks. The roadmap targets a first release in Q1 2028.

projects.name: Strova
projects.summary: An open source 2D animation engine with Flow, custom brushes, and rapid exporting. Roughly 20x smoother playback on the same hardware.
projects.feature: Strova turns your gestures into animation: draw a stroke or move an object and the motion becomes the animation. Targeting release in Q1 2028.
